name: C
notes: Root on string 5, fret 3. The 3rd (E) sits on string 4 under finger 2 and rings again on the open top string.

name: A
notes: The 3rd (C♯) is on string 2 under finger 3 — the finger you move to make Asus2, Asus4, A7 and Amaj7.

name: G
notes: The 3rd (B) is on string 5 under finger 1, and the open B string doubles it.

name: G
notes: The rock G: D on string 2 replaces the open B. Fingers 3 and 4 stay put for Cadd9, Dsus4 and Em7 — the classic anchor.

name: E
notes: The 3rd (G♯) is the single note under finger 1 on string 3. Lift it and you have Em.

name: D
notes: The 3rd (F♯) is on the top string under finger 2 — the finger that moves for Dsus2, Dsus4 and D7.

name: F
notes: The four-string F: a two-string index barre at fret 1. Same notes as the top of the full E-shape F barre.

name: Am
notes: The ♭3 (C) is on string 2 under finger 1. It is the E-chord shape moved over one string set.

name: Em
notes: The ♭3 (G) is the open string 3. Two fingers, all six strings.

name: Dm
notes: The ♭3 (F) is on the top string under finger 1 — compare D, where finger 2 plays F♯ one fret higher.

name: E5
notes: Root, 5th, octave. No 3rd, so it is neither major nor minor.

name: G5
notes: The movable power chord, root on string 6. Slide it anywhere; the name follows the root.

name: C5
notes: The same shape one string set over, root on string 5.
